note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, the era timeline (a first era tag, then a word stack), one top text, one question text and the end card, so 6 graphics and the end card.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: AI raises the baseline for everybody

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “AI raises the baseline for everybody”. Already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:03 for 2 s, lower left above the captions: “Dr. J.D. LaRock”
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 2 s, after the hook text goes out. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line CEO, Network for Teaching Entrepreneurship under it.

mg.title: Era tag
mg.cue: era tag at 00:06 on “The Industrial Revolution”, top band, 5 s.
mg.use: Put it on as he says The Industrial Revolution (00:06) and hold 5 s. Top band. This is the first stop of the era timeline.

mg.title: Era timeline
mg.cue: Era timeline, word stack, top band, 00:12.5 to 00:22.5, one era per line as he says it: “The atomic age” · “The personal computer” · “The AI age”.
mg.use: Start it at 00:12.5. The lines land one by one: slide the clip so each line lands on his word (atomic age about 00:14, personal computer about 00:18, AI age about 00:21). Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Top text

text.main: It raises the baseline for everybody

mg.cue: Top text as he says it: “It raises the baseline for everybody”. Top band, 2.5 s.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:22.5 as he says it and hold 2.5 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Question text

text.main: What are human capabilities in the age of AI?

mg.cue: Question text at about 00:27, top band, 3 s: “What are human capabilities in the age of AI?”
mg.use: Put it on as he asks it (about 00:27) and hold 3 s. Top band. Capital W, question mark at the end.

mg.title: End card
mg.src: NFTE's white logo from the NFTE brand kit (state/nfte/brand/logos, 9 Oct 2026), endcards/index.json.
mg.use: Put it right after the last line at 00:37 and hold it to the very last frame. No fade to black.
